title: Saving an estimate line typed with an inactive number turns the field red and adds nothing
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. QAPL-I1 is inactive here. An open estimate at Staging Heavy Duty that does not hold QAPL-I1 (not the seeded estimate), with at least one line; note its Parts tab and total.
custom_steps:
1. Open the estimate and, on a line, click Add Part.
  2. In the part field type "QAPL-I1".
  3. Close the dropdown; fill Description "QA inactive test" and Qty 1.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Cancel the dialog and reload the estimate.
  6. Open the estimate's Parts tab.
custom_expected:
1. The Part dialog opens.
  2. The dropdown shows only text_part_select_inactive_match "QAPL-I1 is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it."; there is no "Create ... as a new part" and no special-order offer.
  3. Description and Qty hold the typed values; the part field still holds QAPL-I1.
  4. The part field turns red with "QAPL-I1 is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it."; the dialog stays open and nothing is added.
  5. The line has no new part; the estimate total is unchanged.
  6. No part request for QAPL-I1 is listed; only the requests that were there before.
